acf.speaker_position: Director @DiSRUPT Agency & Co-founder @Includability | Certified B Corporation®: Inclusive, Sustainable Talent Acquisition, RPO, Search and Business Advisory
acf.desc_episodes: A Co-founder, Director and ESG Speaker driving cost effective and innovative purpose-driven talent solutions. As part of the leadership team for two certified B Corporations, I provide over 20 years of experience in delivering Inclusive/Sustainable Business Advisory, RPO, Change Management/Project Management Recruitment and Leadership Search (Interim & Permanent) services for amazing organisations. I work with SMEs, start-ups, innovators, and established brands across Insurtech, Fintech, Technology, Renewable Energy/Energy Efficiency, Property/Construction and Consumer Goods. I help business leaders attract and retain the best talent that aligns with their size, growth strategy, mission, vision, and values.
